datasets.name: city_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT city_letter, city_name, city_role, snapshot_date,
       listings, priced_listings, hosts,
       round(median_price_eur, 0)                AS median_price_eur,
       round(100 * open_days_share_365, 1)       AS open_days_pct,
       round(100 * share_blocked, 1)             AS blocked_pct,
       round(avg_review_score, 2)                AS avg_review_score,
       round(100 * share_multi_listing_hosts, 1) AS multi_host_listings_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.city_metrics
ORDER BY city_letter

datasets.name: room_mix
queryLines:
SELECT city_letter, city_name, city_role, room_type, listings,
       round(100 * room_type_mix, 1) AS share_pct,
       round(median_price_eur, 0)    AS median_price_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.room_type_metrics

datasets.name: room_mix_ab
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, room_type, round(median_price_eur, 0) AS median_price_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.room_type_metrics WHERE city_role = 'training'

datasets.name: neighbourhood_prices
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, concat(neighbourhood, ' (', city_letter, ')') AS neighbourhood_label,
       listings, priced_listings, round(median_price_eur, 0) AS median_price_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.neighbourhood_metrics
WHERE meets_price_sample_minimum
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY median_price_eur DESC) <= 6

datasets.name: neighbourhood_counts
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, concat(neighbourhood, ' (', city_letter, ')') AS neighbourhood_label, listings,
       round(100 * listings / sum(listings) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 1) AS share_of_city_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.neighbourhood_metrics
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY listings DESC) <= 6

datasets.name: price_bands
queryLines:
SELECT city_name,
       CASE WHEN price_eur < 50 THEN '01: <50'
            WHEN price_eur < 100 THEN '02: 50-99'
            WHEN price_eur < 150 THEN '03: 100-149'
            WHEN price_eur < 200 THEN '04: 150-199'
            WHEN price_eur < 300 THEN '05: 200-299'
            WHEN price_eur < 500 THEN '06: 300-499'
            WHEN price_eur < 1000 THEN '07: 500-999'
            ELSE '08: 1000+' END AS price_band,
       round(100 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY city_name), 1) AS share_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.listing_facts
WHERE price_eur > 0
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ab_comparison
queryLines:
WITH m AS (SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.city_metrics WHERE city = 'milan'),
     f AS (SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.city_metrics WHERE city = 'florence')
SELECT metric,
       format_number(milan, d) AS milan,
       format_number(florence, d) AS florence,
       format_number(florence - milan, d) AS difference,
       concat(format_number(100 * (florence - milan) / milan, 1), ' %') AS difference_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 'Listings' AS metric, 1 AS o, 0 AS d, CAST(m.listings AS DOUBLE) AS milan, CAST(f.listings AS DOUBLE) AS florence FROM m, f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Hosts', 2, 0, m.hosts, f.hosts FROM m, f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Median price, EUR', 3, 1, round(m.median_price_eur, 1), round(f.median_price_eur, 1) FROM m, f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Days open for booking, %', 4, 1, round(100 * m.open_days_share_365, 1), round(100 * f.open_days_share_365, 1) FROM m, f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Blocked all year, %', 5, 1, round(100 * m.share_blocked, 1), round(100 * f.share_blocked, 1) FROM m, f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Average review score', 6, 2, round(m.avg_review_score, 2), round(f.avg_review_score, 2) FROM m, f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Listings from multi-listing hosts, %', 7, 1, round(100 * m.share_multi_listing_hosts, 1), round(100 * f.share_multi_listing_hosts, 1) FROM m, f
)
ORDER BY o

datasets.name: price_by_guests
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, least(accommodates, 8) AS guests,
       CASE WHEN accommodates >= 8 THEN '8+' ELSE CAST(accommodates AS STRING) END AS guests_label,
       round(median(price_eur), 0) AS median_price_eur, count(*) AS listings
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.listing_facts
WHERE price_eur > 0 AND room_type = 'Entire home/apt' AND city_role = 'training'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY guests

datasets.name: price_by_distance
datasets.displayName: Median price by distance to centre
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, distance_band, round(median(price_eur), 0) AS median_price_eur, count(*) AS listings
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.listing_facts
WHERE price_eur > 0 AND distance_band NOT IN ('unknown', '8+ km') AND city_role = 'training'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY distance_band

datasets.name: model_scorecard
queryLines:
SELECT city_letter, scope, city_role, evaluation_split, n,
       round(model_mae_eur, 2)            AS model_mae_eur,
       round(baseline_mae_eur, 2)         AS baseline_mae_eur,
       round(100 * improvement_share, 1)  AS improvement_pct,
       round(model_median_ae_eur, 1)      AS model_median_ae_eur,
       round(mean_signed_residual_eur, 2) AS mean_signed_residual_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.model_scorecard
WHERE model_version = 'price-v1'
ORDER BY CASE city_letter WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'A+B' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

datasets.name: model_headline
queryLines:
SELECT round(max(CASE WHEN city_letter = 'A+B' THEN model_mae_eur END), 1)    AS ab_model_mae_eur,
       round(max(CASE WHEN city_letter = 'C' THEN model_mae_eur END), 1)      AS c_model_mae_eur,
       round(max(CASE WHEN city_letter = 'C' THEN baseline_mae_eur END), 1)   AS c_baseline_mae_eur,
       round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN city_letter = 'C' THEN model_mae_eur END)
                    / max(CASE WHEN city_letter = 'A+B' THEN model_mae_eur END) - 1), 1) AS c_vs_ab_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.model_scorecard
WHERE model_version = 'price-v1'

datasets.name: mae_long
queryLines:
SELECT scope, 'Model' AS predictor, round(model_mae_eur, 1) AS mae_eur FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.model_scorecard WHERE model_version = 'price-v1'
UNION ALL
SELECT scope, 'Baseline', round(baseline_mae_eur, 1) FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.model_scorecard WHERE model_version = 'price-v1'

datasets.name: pred_vs_actual
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, listing_id, room_type,
       round(actual_price_eur, 0) AS actual_price_eur,
       round(model_prediction_eur, 0) AS predicted_price_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1' AND actual_price_eur <= 1000

datasets.name: error_by_room
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, room_type, count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(absolute_error_eur), 1) AS model_mae_eur,
       round(avg(signed_residual_eur), 1) AS mean_signed_residual_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING count(*) >= 20

datasets.name: error_by_price_band
queryLines:
SELECT price_band, city_name, count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(signed_residual_eur), 0) AS mean_signed_residual_eur,
       round(avg(absolute_error_eur), 0) AS model_mae_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1'
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: error_share_by_band
datasets.displayName: Share of listings vs share of error
queryLines:
SELECT CASE WHEN city_role = 'training' THEN 'Milan + Florence (test)' ELSE concat(city_name, ' (unseen)') END AS population, price_band,
       count(*) AS n,
       round(100 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN city_role = 'training' THEN 'Milan + Florence (test)' ELSE concat(city_name, ' (unseen)') END), 1) AS share_of_listings_pct,
       round(avg(absolute_error_eur), 0) AS model_mae_eur,
       round(100 * sum(absolute_error_eur) / sum(sum(absolute_error_eur)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN city_role = 'training' THEN 'Milan + Florence (test)' ELSE concat(city_name, ' (unseen)') END), 1) AS share_of_total_error_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY population, price_band

datasets.name: error_by_distance
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, distance_band, count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(absolute_error_eur), 1) AS model_mae_eur,
       round(avg(signed_residual_eur), 1) AS mean_signed_residual_eur
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1' AND distance_band <> 'unknown'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING count(*) >= 20
ORDER BY distance_band

datasets.name: venice_neighbourhood_error
queryLines:
SELECT neighbourhood, count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(absolute_error_eur), 1) AS model_mae_eur,
       round(avg(signed_residual_eur), 1) AS mean_signed_residual_eur,
       round(100 * sum(absolute_error_eur) / (SELECT sum(absolute_error_eur) FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
                                        WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1' AND city_letter = 'C'), 1) AS share_of_error_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1' AND city_letter = 'C'
GROUP BY neighbourhood
HAVING count(*) >= 20
ORDER BY share_of_error_pct DESC
LIMIT 12

datasets.name: worst_listings
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, listing_id, listing_url, room_type, neighbourhood, accommodates, distance_band,
       round(actual_price_eur, 0) AS actual_eur,
       round(model_prediction_eur, 0) AS predicted_eur,
       round(baseline_prediction_eur, 0) AS baseline_eur,
       round(signed_residual_eur, 0) AS residual_eur,
       pricing_direction
FROM workspace.airbnb_bi.prediction_details
WHERE is_evaluation_row AND model_version = 'price-v1'
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY abs(signed_residual_eur) DESC) <= 15
ORDER BY abs(signed_residual_eur) DESC

lines: ## Venice is the priciest market (median 231 €/night), Florence 197 €, Milan 163 €; Milan is by far the biggest (25.3k listings)

Inside Airbnb detailed listings, prices in EUR per night. Snapshots: Milan and Florence 2026-09-19 (City A, B: training), Venice 2026-09-16 (City C: new client, never seen by the model). Median price excludes missing and extreme placeholder prices.

frame.title: Key metrics per city: Venice is small but expensive, with the most professional host base
frame.description: Days open = share of the next 365 days open for booking; it is not occupancy. Multi-listing hosts = share of listings whose host has 2+ listings.

frame.title: Entire homes dominate everywhere; Venice has the most private rooms (22 %)
Milan peaks at 100–149 €, Florence and Venice at 200–299 €
San Marco (Venice) and Duomo (Milan) are the most expensive areas

lines: ## Florence looks ~20 % pricier, but at the same distance from the centre Milan costs as much or more: Florence's premium is location

55 % of Florence's priced listings are within 1 km of the Duomo vs 9 % in Milan. Composition, not the city name, explains most of the gap, so distance to the centre is the feature that should transfer to a new city.

frame.title: Side by side: Florence is pricier, more open for booking and has a more professional host base
Florence is pricier in every room type (entire home 208 € vs 169 €), because more of it is central
Price grows with guests in both cities; Florence is higher from 2 guests up
frame.description: Entire homes only; 8 = 8 or more guests.

frame.title: Within 1 km of the Duomo Milan is the pricier city (299 € vs 229 €); its centre premium is 2.3× vs 1.6× in Florence
frame.description: Bands 0–1 / 1–2 / 2–4 / 4–8 km, the same as in the model report; 8+ km omitted (111 Milan listings, 1 in Florence).

lines: ## On Venice the frozen model's error is 40 % higher than on Milan/Florence, because expensive central listings dominate the misses; it still beats the baseline by 25 %

price-v1 was frozen after Week 1 and run unchanged on Venice: no pipeline fix and no model change were needed. Milan/Florence: held-out test set (20 % per city). Venice: every priced listing (unseen). Baseline = training median price for the same room type and number of guests. Residual = predicted − actual; negative = the model under-prices.
